entries.name: Ardeth Platte

expected.charges: Damage to government property — disarming of a B-52 bomber at Andrews Air Force Base, Maryland (Gods of Metal Plowshares)
expected.sentence:
Federal prison time-served plus probation

Verdict as recorded: Yes — federal jury verdict, U.S. District Court for the District of Maryland, September 22, 1998

updates.sentence: Arrested May 17, 1998 and released pending trial. Returned to custody following the September 22-23 bench trial; September is recorded with month precision because reports do not consistently isolate the remand day. Sentenced January 4, 1999. 6 months imprisonment, with credit for detention pending sentencing. The former release endpoint years later is not attributable to this six-month case and has been cleared. March 20, 1999 was a projected release in contemporary reporting, not confirmation of actual discharge. Sources: https://www.laka.org/docu/magazines/nukewatch_pathfinder/1999-1-spring.pdf#page=7 ; https://www.episcopalarchives.org/e-archives/the_witness/pdf/1998_Watermarked/Witness_19981101.pdf#page=13 ; Laffin, The Plowshares Disarmament Chronology 1980-2003, pp.65-66.

sources: Arthur J. Laffin, The Plowshares Disarmament Chronology 1980-2003, printed pp.65-66 / PDF pp.77-78 (user-supplied book).
entries.rationale: Correct this 1998 action separately from later cases. Preserve duplicate rows but align their verified dates; do not turn bail time or a later case release into imprisonment for this case.
